title: Positive-dimensional finitely generated domains have infinitely many maximal ideals
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $A$ be a finitely generated $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] that is an integral domain (a commutative ring with no zero divisors). If the Krull dimension of $A$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] is positive, then $A$ has infinitely many maximal ideals.

source.place: the affine positive-dimension argument used with Tags 00G1 and 00FV: a finite-type domain with only finitely many maximal ideals is zero-dimensional
